topic.angle: A 1977 spacecraft with a tiny memory

card.title: How much memory does Voyager 1 have?

body.question: Voyager 1 was launched by NASA in 1977. About how much total memory does it have, in kilobytes?
body.reveal: The spacecraft's total memory is only 68 kilobytes. When part of a memory chip was corrupted beyond repair, engineers restored communication by rearranging code away from the defective chip, and they deleted unused code to make room.

probes.question: How did engineers work around Voyager 1's defective memory chip?
options: They rearranged code away from the defective chip
They replaced the chip on a spacewalk
They switched to a second Earth-based computer

probes.question: True or false: Voyager 1 was launched by NASA in 1977.
